_note: MEASURED render throughput. Every number here came off a real run — never estimate into this file. The planner (plan-gpu.mjs) prefers these over its priors, so one honest measurement beats any amount of spec-sheet math. Add a row whenever a render is timed on a new card or workload.

gpuPerf._note: Relative throughput prior, used ONLY when no measurement exists for a card. Roughly tracks memory bandwidth x tensor throughput for diffusion sampling. RTX_6000Ada = 1.0 by definition.

gpuVram._note: GB of VRAM per card, for ruling out offload-thrashing before renting.

hunyuan-1.5-i2v-720p-fp16.vramNote: 16.65GB fp16 unet + 9.4GB text encoder + 2.5GB vae + activations for 121 frames at 1280x720. MEASURED at 43.3/49GB on a 6000 Ada — already offloading, so 48GB is the floor, not comfortable.

measured.note: cfg 6 = two model evaluations per step. VRAM 43.3/49GB with dynamic offload, which is part of why it is this slow.
one still, 1152x640, lora 1.35. Includes no model load (warm).
